purpose: Prevent explicit executable paths and inline PATH overrides from borrowing a familiar command's risk classification.
baseline: A disposable executable named version-probe wrote a local marker when invoked as ./version-probe --version. The real Bash gate auto-approved it at Balanced with the sandbox disabled; the regression test failed because execution succeeded.
change: Unknown version commands and explicit executable paths require approval. Inline PATH assignments are retained for risk analysis. The established ./gradlew and ./mvnw verification forms remain available at Balanced.
regression: project_executable_cannot_bypass_balanced_approval_by_name_or_version checks a version probe, scripts named cargo and echo, and direct and env-wrapped PATH overrides without allowing their marker to be created.
terminal_control: target/tui-verification/e2e/20261106T152907Z-12040: verifier isolation and compound permission flow passed on the final build.

compatibility.result: 3/3 diagnose, fix, and verify repetitions passed.

limitations: Bare executable names still depend on the inherited PATH; the Gradle and Maven wrapper exceptions deliberately execute project code. Other environment variables and execution surfaces are not comprehensively classified by this change. This is not a sandbox or a complete qualification of issue 153.

compiler_and_loader_followup.baseline_result: A local RUSTC_WRAPPER ran during cargo check under the Balanced gate with sandbox off; the marker existed and command execution was recorded. The overall mock task was blocked by its separate completion guard.
compiler_and_loader_followup.candidate_result: The same attempt recorded no reached command and no marker. The test intentionally requires the marker, so it fails after the fix.
compiler_and_loader_followup.macos_loader_control: A disposable DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES library created a marker when node --version was run directly, demonstrating that a version flag does not prevent loader code from executing.
compiler_and_loader_followup.deepseek_result: 3/3 routine diagnose, fix, and verify repetitions passed.
compiler_and_loader_followup.limitations: The guard covers PATH, explicit Rust compiler and wrapper overrides, and LD_/DYLD_ variables. Other runtime, build, and inherited environment settings can affect execution; this is not comprehensive environment isolation.
